description: NIST's CTC-01 (the committed real/nist-ctc-01), solid #101: the crease where two equal cylinders f85 and f86 whose axes meet cross, an ellipse, filleted alone at r 1.910, the battery's radius from its sample today. One end is a vertex of three edges with the plane f68 across, the other a vertex of four with the planes f20 and f71 across, a fan. The fillet's ball centre runs on an ellipse, the section of the two offset cylinders. Arris refuses it Unsupported(cylinder surface × cylinder surface); Open CASCADE builds it (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 1)
